answer: Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 12 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in raven and haven lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the echo graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1686 impostors cost 478 times the honest price and take 29 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
